g.text: The J++ part taken out of the changed prompt, rung by rung; answers lost beyond a random part
L to L+3: L, the layer fixed in advance, and the three layers after it; the band was fixed before the run
(Fig. 6b shows how deep the bridge word is still read).
Every token: rung 5 takes out the same 25 lens directions at every token (ours); rung 6 each token's own
top-10 lens directions over Zach's band (his).
† Muse's rung 6 ran at L23–29; his band is L36–42, where it was not run.
